agent_engine.note: No Agent Engine (Reasoning Engine) instance existed in this project before this session -- confirmed via a real reasoningEngines.list call returning an empty result. Created for real via the Vertex AI REST API; this is a new, additive GCP resource, not a change to the already-deployed judged Cloud Run service.

real_bugs_found_and_fixed_by_running_thi: Every session id in this codebase is customer_id:web / customer_id:whatsapp, and VertexAiSessionService's real server-side validation (found from the actual 400 response, stricter than the client library's own pre-check regex) is 'session_id can only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens' -- a colon is rejected outright, and so is any uppercase letter (every customer_id in this tenant is uppercase, e.g. CUST-MEENA). Fixed with agents/vertex_sessions.py::vertex_safe_id() plus a translating VertexSafeSessionService wrapper, so every other call site keeps using the original ids untouched.

ADK's InvocationContext (used internally by Runner.run_async) is a pydantic model whose session_service field is validated with isinstance(value, BaseSessionService) -- a plain duck-typed wrapper class implementing the same methods was rejected outright ('Input should be an instance of BaseSessionService'), even though every method signature matched. Fixed by making VertexSafeSessionService actually subclass BaseSessionService.

not_done_in_this_session: The live, judged Cloud Run deployment was NOT redeployed with TAAL_SESSION_BACKEND=vertex set -- that is a live-service behavior change (the deployed service already runs TAAL_MODEL_BACKEND=vertex, so this is a genuinely separate, additive config flag, not bundled into the same flag) and needs its own explicit go-ahead, per this session's established posture on live redeploys.
